title: Amazing !!
text: I really enjoyed this tour, I recommend it to anyone who wants to visit Seville and discover its beautiful traditions. The staff was really nice too.
author: emilielavoyageuse

title: A very authentic experience
text: We did Flamenco for a Day and we loved it. The walk through the Macarena was beautiful, full of history and art. The workshop, very fun and enjoyable. we ended with a talk where we better understood the language of flamenco. You can see the passion with which they transmit it. A highly recommended experience to experience flamenco from within.
author: Stay50863375674
